user_problem: Two supplied coding systems need a traceable mapping that preserves one-to-many and unmapped relationships.
unique_output: A crosswalk table with source code, target code, mapping type, rationale source, and unresolved entries.
required_input: Both code lists, definitions, approved mapping notes, and any effective-date or scope constraints.
critical_rule: Do not map codes by similar labels alone; unsupported matches remain unmapped even when they look obvious.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is taxonomy-gap-finder; this reconciles two coding schemes rather than assessing assignment coverage within one taxonomy.
acceptance_scenario: Input A1='Books', B7='Print books', B8='E-books', and note A1 maps to B7+B8. Output records a one-to-many mapping with the note and leaves A2='Music' unmapped.
